_comment: Config for the cross-repo drift gate (scripts/gate/). Both checks are delegated to the shared @bounded-systems/drift-gate engine. guestRoom.rev is informational — the rev the golden was last generated against, for local reproducibility; the checked-in golden is the effective pin for the surface check. localPath is where CI checks guest-room out; local runs fall back to ../guest-room. The surface projection is produced by ts-morph (pinned via drift-gate's typescript dependency, recorded in the golden's _generated.typescript), so it no longer depends on the deno version — CI runs the org-standard v2.x.
